name: Don't Hide
source:
You've captured the unwanted attention of the strongest (and scariest) person you have ever met... HOW BLESSED YOU ARE!

You managed to escape from the house where he kept you... 
But for how long? What will be your priority: 
Your safety or Your freedom? 
Whatever you choose, Good luck!

[From [url=https://reiynm.itch.io/dont-hide-complete-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你引起了这辈子见过的最强大、也最可怕的人的注意，尽管你根本不想要……你可真“幸运”啊！

你设法逃出了他囚禁你的屋子……
但又能逃多久？你会优先选择什么：
自身的安全，还是自由？
无论如何选择，祝你好运！

[摘自[url=https://reiynm.itch.io/dont-hide-complete-demo]itch.io[/url]]
